incidentTitle: create user ID asha and Praneeth in control plane
summary: The control plane node lacks local OS user accounts for 'asha' and 'Praneeth', preventing direct system access and audit compliance. This procedure creates both users with dedicated home directories, assigns them to the 'wheel' group for sudo privileges, configures SSH key-based authentication by deploying authorized_keys, and verifies sudoers syntax to ensure immediate administrative capability.
proposedCommands: ssh root@192.168.100.101 "for user in asha Praneeth; do id -u "$user" &>/dev/null || useradd -m -s /bin/bash -G wheel "$user"; done"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "for user in asha Praneeth; do mkdir -p /home/"$user"/.ssh; chmod 700 /home/"$user"/.ssh; chown "$user":"$user" /home/"$user"/.ssh; done"

ssh root@192.168.100.101 "cat > /home/asha/.ssh/authorized_keys << 'EOF'
ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQ... asha@workstation
EOF
cat > /home/Praneeth/.ssh/authorized_keys << 'EOF'
ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQ... Praneeth@workstation
EOF"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "for user in asha Praneeth; do chmod 600 /home/"$user"/.ssh/authorized_keys; chown "$user":"$user" /home/"$user"/.ssh/authorized_keys; done && visudo -c"
